# Megamind Labs UI

> A CSS-only, greyscale wireframe kit. Link one stylesheet, put `class="mm mm-canvas"` on the body, and build screens from `mm-*` classes.

- [Rules for building screens](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/gitcamy/megamind-labs-ui@main/AGENTS.md): setup, the rules of the system, presenting flows, and the component list.
- [Class and token reference](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/gitcamy/megamind-labs-ui@main/reference/classes.md): every `mm-*` class and CSS variable.
- [Stylesheet](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/gitcamy/megamind-labs-ui@main/megamind-labs-ui.css): the single file to link.
- [Source](https://github.com/gitcamy/megamind-labs-ui): repository, starter screens and the React wrappers.
